scripts.build: npm run build:site && npm run build:search
scripts.verify:hugo158: pwsh -NoLogo -NoProfile -Command "$output = hugo --gc --minify --logLevel info 2>&1; $deprecated = $output | Select-String -Pattern '(?i)deprecat'; if ($deprecated) { $deprecated | ForEach-Object { $_.Line }; throw '检测到 Hugo 弃用相关日志，请先完成迁移。' }; Write-Host '未检测到 Hugo 弃用相关日志。'"
